title: An Old Space Game Is Coming Back
summary:
Fans of old video games got good news this weekend. At the Portland Retro Gaming Expo, a big event for classic games, a producer from Electronic Arts made an announcement. The game Wing Commander 3: Heart of the Tiger is getting a remaster. A remaster is a new, improved version of an old game.

Wing Commander was a popular series of space flying games for computers in the 1990s.

The producer, Jim Vessella, said he found the original tapes from when the game was made. A fan said he found more than 600 tapes.

The new version will be for the game's 30th anniversary. Its videos will be cleaned up, and it will run more smoothly. It may also include the first three games.

In the game, players fly as a space pilot fighting giant cat-like aliens called the Kilrathi. The game has movie scenes with real actors, including Mark Hamill, who played Luke Skywalker in Star Wars.
why_it_matters: Fixing up old games lets kids today play classics their parents may have loved.
